name: Female Musician
summary: Earthenware with polychrome pigments。20.9 × 13.3 × 13.5 cm (8 1/4 × 5 1/4 × 5 5/16 in.)。Gift of Arthur M. Wood
history: Young female musicians who hailed from oasis cities on the Silk Road in Central Asia captivated the Tang court by playing a combination of Chinese and foreign instru-ments. This ensemble features girls playing the cymbals, a vertical flute or oboe, pan-pipes, and an upright angular harp. Two musicians in the back row hold vessel-like instruments that have not been identified.
